formatter=null|Closure|string；display=nu: formatter=null|Closure|string; display=null|Closure; width=200; height=200. This example uses a 200×200 image. Short labels do not change the full copied value.
columns 为字段数组；formatter 接收字段名并绑定当前行。字段使用: columns is an array of fields; formatter receives the field name and is bound to the current row. Labels follow the selected language. Values longer than 30 characters show a tooltip.
limit=15，before=1 保留开头；0 保留末尾。本例仅使用固定纯文本: limit=15; before=1 keeps the beginning, 0 keeps the end. This example uses fixed plain text only. Layer interprets HTML, so do not pass raw user input.
limit=100，end=\"...\"；本例保留末尾 24 字。点击双箭头展: limit=100, end="...". This example keeps the last 24 characters. Use the double arrow to expand or collapse. Scalar values are escaped automatically.

无参数；触发同一张 Dcat 表单内原生 button.submit，执行相同验: No arguments. Triggers the native button.submit in the same Dcat form, using the same validation and save flow.
